sampling_proof.local_intervals: choose disjoint intervals I_p around log p with length delta_p comparable to the minimum adjacent logarithmic prime gap
sampling_proof.prime_gap_bound: consecutive odd primes differ by at least 2, hence delta_p >= c/p after harmless treatment of finitely many small primes

wall_linking_form.definition: omega_wall(f,g)=sum_p([f]_(log p) conjugate(p^(-1/2)g(log p)_avg)-p^(-1/2)f(log p)_avg conjugate([g]_(log p)))
wall_linking_form.global_seam: the wall at 0 contributes one additional finite-dimensional bounded term

complete_linking.source_normalization: the p^(-1/2) factor is the already declared arithmetic half-density, not a fitted convergence weight

orbit_extension.definition: transport omega_link to each H^(j) and sum over four presentations

disposition: The missing dual trace control is supplied canonically by the existing prime half-density. Weighted logarithmic-prime sampling is bounded on the broken-H1 carrier, so the full regular-plus-wall ordered Wronskian form extends continuously to the completed four-presentation orbit. Item 4 is analytically closed; only conservative metric identification remains.
